scripts.validate: for preset in *.json *.json5; do case "$preset" in package.json|package-lock.json) continue ;; esac; renovate-config-validator --strict "$preset" || exit; done
scripts.test: node tests/schedule.mjs && node tests/custom-managers.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/automerge.mjs tests/commit-messages.test.mjs tests/go.test.mjs tests/helm.test.mjs tests/pr-labels.test.mjs
